tara (devex): Heads up — the onboarding quickstarts are leaking PII in logs and the Go quickstart isn't preserving request ids across retries. New hire ran examples and pasted output.

olivia (sdk-py): Oof, what's the log sample? We should never have emails or raw tokens in examples.

tara (devex): From the Python quickstart run:

```
INFO 2026-03-05T09:43:12Z request_id=xyz-789 user_id=201 email=dev@example.com model=redwood-1
DEBUG 2026-03-05T09:43:12Z bearer_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR...rest
```

tara (devex): And the Go quickstart created new trace roots when the server returned a 500 and the client retried — so the dashboard shows separate traces for the same logical op.

naveen (sdk-go): The Go example currently uses the default http client + our retry middleware. We forgot to explicitly call req = req.WithContext(ctx) in the retry loop in the example helper. That will drop propagated headers like `traceparent` and any `x-request-id`.

lin (sre): That explains the duplicate root spans. Also the SDKs don't uniformly apply a redaction sanitizer in quickstart/dev mode. We should standardize a small redaction filter used only in example/dev profiles (omit in prod).

olivia (sdk-py): We already have a tiny sanitizer in the Python SDK but it's opt-in. Quickstart envs currently don't enable it by default. I'm happy to flip it on for the quickstarts and document how to opt out.

naveen (sdk-go): For Go I'll bump the quickstart to v0.6.4 which contains the fix for context copying, and add a note and helper in the repo that wires OTEL propagators for users who follow the quickstart. Something like:

```
prop := propagation.TraceContext{}
otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(prop))
// ensure retry uses the request context
req = req.WithContext(ctx)
```

lin (sre): Can we also add a small e2e that simulates server error on first attempt and asserts the same `x-request-id` or `traceparent` header on subsequent attempts? That'll catch regressions if someone changes retry logic.

tara (devex): Yes please. Also two UX things: set LOG_LEVEL=info in the quickstart .envs so folks don't get overwhelmed, and make the sanitizer also scrub tokens in stack traces (e.g., replace middle of token with `***`) when debug is enabled locally. We want safe local debugging but no secrets on shared examples.

olivia (sdk-py): I'll open PRs: one to change quickstart envs and docs, another to enable the sanitizer in quickstart configs and add a small regex for token masking in logger output.

naveen (sdk-go): I'll open a PR to bump the Go sample, add the `req.WithContext` fix, and include a tiny wrapper `telemetry/start.go` that sets up propagators and an opt-in sanitizer for examples. Keep it explicit so production users don't get unexpected behavior.

lin (sre): I'll add the e2e retry-propagation test to infra and wire it into the CI gate for quickstarts. Test should fail if header values differ across attempts.

ci-bot: Created checklist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/issues/301 — items: set info log level, enable sanitizer in quickstarts, mask tokens in traces, bump go sample, add retry propagation e2e.

tara (devex): Thanks team. One last ask: add a one-liner to the onboarding checklist that new hires verify logs in quickstarts are redacted and that `x-request-id` traces remain consistent during induced retries. Saves future confusion.

olivia (sdk-py): On it.

naveen (sdk-go): PRs: #201 quickstart env defaults, #202 go sample bump + context fix, #203 telemetry wrapper.

tara (devex): Great. Closing the loop — I'll update the template repo once PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
